'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Michael Erisman LS Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Light) (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Erisman]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Light) (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)|OVS15-30-Tatooine_Lars_Moisture_Farm-remaster.webp|label=Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm (Light) (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Erisman
* '''Deck name:''' Cornholio?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
